gooo_source:
package filenames
namespace filenames
entity Text id "gooo://filenames/text"
entity Integer id "gooo://filenames/integer"
entity Boolean id "gooo://filenames/boolean"
entity FileInfo id "gooo://filenames/info" fields {
    field source id "gooo://filenames/source" type boolean required one
    field stem id "gooo://filenames/stem" type string required one
    field bytes id "gooo://filenames/bytes" type integer required one
}

activity HasPrefix(Text, Text) -> Boolean computes `return len(input0) >= len(input1) && input0[:len(input1)] == input1`
activity HasSuffix(Text, Text) -> Boolean computes `return len(input0) >= len(input1) && input0[len(input0)-len(input1):] == input1`
activity StripSuffix(Text, Text) -> Text computes `if HasSuffix(input0, input1) { return input0[:len(input0)-len(input1)] }; return input0`
activity ByteLength(Text) -> Integer computes `return int64(len(input))`

activity Classify(Text) -> FileInfo computes "var suffix = HasSuffix(input, \".gooo\")\nvar visible = !HasPrefix(input, \".\")\nvar stem = StripSuffix(input, \".gooo\")\nvar bytes = ByteLength(input)\nreturn FileInfo{source: suffix && visible, stem: stem, bytes: (bytes)}" assembling {
    baseline "let suffix = HasSuffix(input, \".gooo\")\nlet visible = !HasPrefix(input, \".\")\nlet stem = StripSuffix(input, \".gooo\")\nlet bytes = ByteLength(input)\nreturn FileInfo{source: suffix && visible, stem: stem, bytes: 0}"
    picked "source" -> "value_first"
    picked "stem" -> "value_first"
    picked "bytes" -> "value_second"
    choice "source" field_value at "0" alternative "suffix || visible" intent "Require both the suffix and visible-name conditions."
    choice "stem" field_value at "1" alternative "input" intent "Return the name after removing the suffix."
    choice "bytes" field_value at "2" alternative "bytes" intent "Return the UTF-8 byte length of the input name."
    value_case "[\"main.gooo\"]" -> "{\"bytes\":9,\"source\":true,\"stem\":\"main\"}"
    value_case "[\".secret.gooo\"]" -> "{\"bytes\":12,\"source\":false,\"stem\":\".secret\"}"
    value_case "[\"notes.txt\"]" -> "{\"bytes\":9,\"source\":false,\"stem\":\"notes.txt\"}"
    value_case "[\"\"]" -> "{\"bytes\":0,\"source\":false,\"stem\":\"\"}"
    value_case "[\"언어.gooo\"]" -> "{\"bytes\":11,\"source\":true,\"stem\":\"언어\"}"
    attempts "8"
}
